findings.id: gap C — inventor modification prerequisites (engine CROSS-FILE GAPS line, print premise innovation-5 / innovation-2)

backfillRows.why: AoN innovation-5, Revolutionary Modifications (Level 15) — Energy Barrier, verbatim: "You must have the harmonic oscillator, metallic reactance, or phlogistonic regulator modification to select this modification." `requiresModification` is the ClassFeature field batch 036 added for exactly this clause; its reader is inventorModificationOptions (src/rules/build.ts:2786) and ANY ONE of the listed ids satisfies it, which is what the printed or-list means. All three named ids are armor-innovation-modification records in core.json at level 1, below Energy Barrier's 15, so the gate is always satisfiable. The record carries no requiresModification today, so this is a first assignment — no supersedes, no collision.

AoN innovation-5, Revolutionary Modifications (Level 15) — Physical Protections, verbatim: "You must have the dense plating, layered mesh, or tensile absorption breakthrough modification to select this modification." Same lane and same or-list semantics as energy-barrier above. The three named ids are armor-innovation-modification records at level 7, below Physical Protections' 15. First assignment — no supersedes.

AoN innovation-2, Breakthrough Modifications (Level 7) — Marvelous Gears, verbatim: "You must have the wonder gears modification to select this modification." A single-id list: the gate passes only when wonder-gears (construct-innovation-modification, level 1) is one of the character's picks. The record itself was CREATED by an earlier batch-036 overlay row ({create:true}); this adds one top-level field to it, so there is no collision with that row or with its separate description row.

AoN innovation-2, Breakthrough Modifications (Level 7) — Turret Configuration, verbatim: "You must have the projectile launcher modification to select this modification." Single-id gate; projectile-launcher is a construct-innovation-modification at level 1. Same created-record situation as marvelous-gears — a first assignment of a field the record does not carry.

AoN innovation-2, Revolutionary Modifications (Level 15) — Miracle Gears, verbatim: "You must have the marvelous gears modification to select this modification." Single-id gate, and it CHAINS: marvelous-gears is itself gated on wonder-gears by the row above, so a construct inventor who wants Miracle Gears at 15th must have spent the 1st-level slot on Wonder Gears and the 7th on Marvelous Gears. `held` at src/rules/build.ts:8512 is the RAW picks of all three tiers, so the chain is judged against what the player chose rather than against what already validated — each link is tested on its own printed clause, which is what print says.

findings.note: Five rows, one lane. The reader shipped earlier in this same batch (src/rules/build.ts:2786, cited `// batch 036: hyper-boosters#prerequisite`) and hyper-boosters was its only data row until now, so five of the six printed prerequisite clauses in the inventor chapter had no carrier. The gap line as parked was GARBLED — it listed the prerequisite ids as if they were the owners ("layered-mesh [\"speed-boosters\"]"); the owners above were re-derived from public/ast/classFeatures.json against the mirror and every one of the thirteen ids was verified present in core.json with the prerequisite at a strictly lower tier than the record naming it.

findings.id: gap E — speed-boosters Overdrive step (verifier's own line; follow-through on CONFIRMED hyper-boosters#overdrive)

backfillRows.why: AoN innovation-5, Initial Modifications — Speed Boosters, verbatim: "You gain a +5-foot status bonus to your Speed, which increases to a +10-foot status bonus when under the effects of Overdrive." (the mirror writes the first hyphen as U+2011). The standing +5 landed as `landSpeedBonus` 5 earlier in this batch; the Overdrive step had no carrier at all, so a speed-boosters-only inventor read +5 whether Overdrive was on or off. `whileActive` is the live lane activeStateGrants gates on classResources['overdrive'] (src/rules/derive.ts:1185, folded into deriveSpeeds at :5233), and land grants are ADDITIVE over landSpeedBonus, so +5 while the toggle is on reads exactly as the printed +10. WG agrees and is stricter than we were: `wg-show "Speed Boosters" --raw` is one conditional, IF ACTIVE_MODES NOT_INCLUDES overdrive AND NOT_INCLUDES 'critical overdrive' THEN SPEED +5 status ELSE SPEED +10 status. First assignment of the field on this record.

RECALIBRATION forced by the row above, and the exact twin of what already happened to this record's landSpeedBonus. SUPERSEDES the shipped overlay row {category:'classFeatures',id:'hyper-boosters',field:'whileActive',value:[{state:'overdrive',speeds:{land:10}}]}; that array held one clause and nothing else, so the whole superseded value is merged here with only its number changed. AoN innovation-5, Breakthrough Modifications — Hyper Boosters, verbatim: "You gain a +10-foot status bonus to your Speed, which increases to a +20-foot status bonus when you're in Overdrive." The 10 was correct only while speed-boosters carried NOTHING for the Overdrive step. Batch 036's own requiresModification row makes speed-boosters a hard prerequisite of hyper-boosters, so the pair is never separable and every hyper-boosters number is a DELTA over the speed-boosters number underneath it — which is precisely why the landSpeedBonus row was superseded 10 -> 5 with the note "derive.ts ADDS the two". deriveSpeeds adds whileActive land grants the same way (src/rules/derive.ts:5233 pushes each into grantSources, :5310 does `speeds.land = (speeds.land ?? 0) + v`), so leaving it at 10 beside the new speed-boosters 5 would pay the pair +25 feet in Overdrive against a printed +20. With both rows the arithmetic is: speed-boosters alone 5 base / 5+5 = +10 in Overdrive; the pair 5+5 = +10 base / +10 +5+5 = +20 in Overdrive. Both printed numbers, exactly.

findings.note: Two rows, ONE mechanic — the Overdrive Speed ladder. The second row is a supersede of a row applied earlier in this same batch, not another group's pending spec: gap E is the verifier's own parked line and no family was assigned either record's whileActive this round. Code follow-through in the same chunk: the FEAT_SITUATIONAL['speed-boosters'] star is removed (src/rules/situationalBonuses.ts:1467), because once the row lands the star repeats a number the Speed row already shows.
